nodes.summary: The partial document covers the Kurhaus Tannenfels, which opened in 1902 as a thermal bath house with a 34-degree water source. It currently offers 84 rooms and three conference rooms. The building is protected as a historical monument, and the 1928 glass-covered entrance hall was restored in 2024 in accordance with preservation guidelines and is now fully open.
